strict_scale_note: Rebuilt as CodeCommit platform control plane under large_system_strict.
production_characteristics: CLI and HTTP API share authorize path
persistent JSONL audit and outbox with retry

root_cause_clusters.RC1_ACTION_MATCH: Action matching uses prefix/substring; Action * skips Resource ARN checks.
root_cause_clusters.RC2_CONDITIONS: Bool MFA and IpAddress CIDR skipped; explicit Deny statements ignored; missing MFA treated as true.
root_cause_clusters.RC3_QUORUM: Author, duplicate, and off-pool approvals count toward required; required hardcoded.
root_cause_clusters.RC4_MERGE: merge always creates merge commits; reports fast_forward true falsely.
root_cause_clusters.RC5_TRIGGER: deliver mints random event_id, always appends journal, no ref normalization.
root_cause_clusters.RC6_AUDIT_OUTBOX: audit drops Deny decisions; outbox skips enqueue on deliver; retry ignores backoff.
root_cause_clusters.RC7_API_BYPASS: HTTP API merge/push paths skip authorize or use weaker checks than CLI.
